author: TeIq
content: Implemented. Migration 38 adds labeler_profiles table. case-view's fetch_all_labels_for_subject now LEFT JOINs against labeler_profiles to populate src_display_name + src_handle on every label row. labeler-discovery worker fires a detached tokio task on every new labeler insert that calls app.bsky.labeler.getServices and UPSERTs the profile, so display names trickle in as the network is discovered. 532 lib tests pass; clippy clean.
